thread:
Ivy (partnerships): OrbitAI preview confirmed for next week. Need NDA signed, customs clearance, and bench acceptance criteria. Can we assign owners? @Dmitri for logistics, @Rae for HW checks, @Sana for bench, @Ollie for legal.
Dmitri (partner-ops): I can own shipping and customs. Carrier ETA Wed evening. Please confirm rack U and sustained power draw.
Rae (hw-eng): Hardware is 2x1U nodes, reserve 2U. Power: 1.3kW sustained per rack. Firmware tags: orbit-2026-06-01 and orbit-2026-06-14 (perf patches). Will capture firmware and kernel versions on arrival.
Sana (bench): I'll lead bench. Proposed minimal matrix: single-stream latency (seq=4096), batch4 throughput, 6h soak, and 300-sample QA sweep vs redwood/v1.2. Acceptance: p99 within 10% and quality delta <1%.
Ivy (partnerships): Also need a short partner feedback template: perf summary, infra notes, firmware log, action items with owners, and go/no-go. Who drafts?
Sana (bench): I'll draft the template and include charts (latency hist, p50/p95/p99) plus a triage checklist. Runner snippet for infra below:
```bash
./bench-runner --model redwood/v1.2 --seq 4096 --batch 1 --out s3://redwood-preview/orbitai/metrics.json
```
We'll export token-level timings and p99/p99.9.
Ollie (legal): NDA draft received. I'll redline telemetry scope and embargo language. Request partner confirm no access to raw request payloads. Target: signed NDA by Tue EOD.
Dmitri (partner-ops): Shipping labels and commercial invoice uploaded to the shared drive. Posting tracking once carrier confirms pickup.
Rae (hw-eng): Heads-up: if we detect PCIe lane remapping issues, grab lspci, dmesg and vendor module versions. Will reserve isolated GPU nodes if passthrough is needed.
NotifyBot: Calendar event created: "OrbitAI Preview - Lab Week" Wed-Fri. Invitees: Ivy, Dmitri, Rae, Sana, Ollie.
Ivy (partnerships): Action items recap: Ollie - NDA by Tue; Dmitri - shipping + customs by Wed; Rae - firmware + infra checks by Thu; Sana - bench doc + runner by Mon AM. I'll run a day-zero sync Mon 09:00.
Sana (bench): Flagging a potential blocker: orbit-2026-06-14 changes quant kernels; will add a micro-benchmark to isolate token timing differences.
Rae (hw-eng): If kernel differences surface, we'll capture kernel+module versions and request partner stable image fallback.
Ivy (partnerships): Thanks team. Keeping thread as primary coordination for day-zero items. :white_check_mark:
